title: Ah Tutku Beni Öldürür Müsün?
author: Cahide Birgül
description: Set in a once-grand building in Ortaköy, this gothic tale follows the Mabeyinoğulları family, marked by mysterious deaths and accidents that drive tenants away. When two young men find themselves drawn into the “haunted” house—whether as invited or uninvited guests— they uncover chilling secrets, fueled by gossip, greed, and forbidden passion. A gripping tale of obsession and spectral echoes of the past.
english_title: Oh Passion, Will You Kill Me?
